a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) means we both almost certainly fail. We only reach round 3 about 4% of the time. I'm proposing a change openly rather than breaking the deal behind your back. I'll take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round and never take another cell, so the generator can build up 4 for you. If we both grab now, the random split could leave us both short. So please operate in round 1. Tell me if you strongly object.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said in my opening. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take another cell, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If our takes collided and I end up short, I'll say so plainly. Otherwise, count on me to operate with you until you have 4.
